title: Zesty Rich Norwegian Macaroni Pasta
description: A rich and velvety one-pot Norwegian dish featuring macaroni, made in a cataplana vessel with a blend of ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly ingredients, finished under the broil for a crispy top.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the cataplana vessel over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture.
Add the macaroni, vegetable broth, dried thyme, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the shredded norwegian cheese until melted and well combined.
Transfer the cataplana vessel to the broil and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until the top is crispy and golden brown.
Remove from the broil and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
